reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: handleConsent has an active non-test caller (consent-form.tsx L53), entry point is an untrusted end-user (no trust_assumptions in scope), and src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via the OAuth consent endpoint by submitting the consent form under any condition that causes a transient DB failure in create_user_consent (e.g., connection timeout, constraint violation on duplicate consent), causing the server to silently skip recording consent (consentError logged but never checked at L74) and unconditionally issue a valid authorization code, resulting in an access token granted without a recorded user consent record — violating the invariant forall consent: gen_code(consent) => exists(DB.user_consents). The analogous codeError guard at L95-103 confirms this omission is not by design.
